app-medica.title: Medical App
app-medica.subtitle: Mobile app
app-medica.description: Hybrid mobile app for appointment management and health tracking, built with Ionic, Angular and Capacitor for Android.
app-medica.overview: An app designed to simplify managing medical appointments and tracking a patient's health history from their phone, with a native-like experience thanks to Capacitor.
architecture: Frontend built with Ionic + Angular, packaged for Android with Capacitor.
Consumes a REST API to sync appointments and health data.

web-agro.title: Agro Web
web-agro.subtitle: Web platform
web-agro.description: Web platform for the agricultural sector, built with ASP.NET Core and Angular.
web-agro.overview: A platform to digitize processes in the agricultural sector, combining an ASP.NET Core backend with a modern Angular interface.
architecture: REST API built with ASP.NET Core and Entity Framework for data access.
Angular frontend consuming the API to manage the information.

form-engine.title: Form Engine
form-engine.subtitle: Form builder engine
form-engine.description: Dynamic form engine with an ASP.NET Core backend and an Angular frontend.
form-engine.overview: An engine that lets you define and render dynamic forms without hardcoding each field, meant to be reused across different processes.
architecture: ASP.NET Core backend that exposes the form definitions via a REST API.
Angular frontend that interprets that definition and renders the form dynamically.
